steps.title: plantgen foliage library in play
steps.intro: A new alpine map (seed 1234) saved as _reopen_plantgen, played with treecube, then switched to the plantgen package through FoliageLibrary.switch (the debug toggle's code path): Root reloads the table through play_level and the load regenerates the rows the saved map cannot resolve. The test level is removed at the end.
